packages.title: Eval_D domain and codomain
packages.objective: Define the admissible input type, result type, context parameter, and undefined-result behavior of Eval_D,C.
packages.why_it_exists: Downstream D preservation and collapse claims cannot be typed without this contract.

execution_steps.description: Define Eval_D,C signature and partial behavior.
Write valid, invalid, and undefined fixtures.
Submit additive note for human review.

acceptance_tests: All fixture cases type-check against the specification
No injectivity or reversibility is assumed

packages.success_definition: A downstream agent can execute Eval_D,C examples without importing unstated type or undefined-result semantics.

escalation.if_blocked: Escalate missing TYPE_PROJECTION contract to human review and keep OPEN.
escalation.if_contradiction_found: Open contradiction record and invalidate downstream plans.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Attach counterexample and reopen any dependent certificate.

packages.title: Context threshold
packages.objective: Define epsilon_a,C and establish whether it is fixed, context-indexed, or derived.
packages.why_it_exists: Admissibility and continuation decisions require reproducible threshold semantics.
packages.success_definition: Threshold behavior is reproducible and context-indexed without silent implementation dependence.

escalation.if_contradiction_found: Route competing threshold definitions to notation review.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Record threshold failure and keep OPEN.

packages.title: Typed transition preservation
packages.objective: Show which type properties are preserved when A|E maps through Pi_D into TYPE_PROJECTION.
packages.why_it_exists: A projection claim requires a typed derivation rather than analogy.
packages.success_definition: The transition preservation claim is formally specified and independently checked.
failure_conditions: proof depends on undefined D types

escalation.if_blocked: Return to OBL-D-001A and keep this obligation BLOCKED.
escalation.if_contradiction_found: Preserve both derivations and open contradiction review.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Invalidate preservation candidate and reopen definition.

packages.title: Representable distinction preservation
packages.objective: Define and test what distinction relation Pi_D preserves.
packages.why_it_exists: It separates semantic preservation from operational residue proxies.
assumptions: representable distinction is not defined from outcome labels

execution_steps.description: Define representable distinction independently of topology outcome.

acceptance_tests: Predicate is computable without outcome labels

packages.success_definition: Representable distinction has an independent typed predicate with bounded evidence and explicit failure cases.

escalation.if_blocked: Request additional immutable specification or approved tool.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Reopen preservation claim and attach counterexample.

packages.title: Non-collapse boundary
packages.objective: Specify the boundary between ordinary residue and loss of representability.
packages.why_it_exists: Projection semantics require an explicit failure boundary rather than an undefined collapse metaphor.
assumptions: collapse is typed partiality or loss of required representability

execution_steps.description: Define collapse and residue as separate typed outcomes.
Construct positive, negative, and boundary fixtures.
Issue certificate only after all tests pass.

acceptance_tests: Positive, negative, and boundary fixtures classify consistently
Counterexamples are exhausted within declared scope

packages.success_definition: A typed rule distinguishes residue from collapse across declared fixtures and bounded countermodel space.
failure_conditions: collapse is defined only by post-hoc label
counterexample space is narrowed without justification

escalation.if_blocked: Suspend until OBL-D-001A and OBL-D-001D certificates are valid.
escalation.if_contradiction_found: Preserve contradiction and reopen boundary definition.
escalation.if_counterexample_found: Automatically reopen this obligation and invalidate dependent certificates.
